title: Morning Brief - Prem
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) here, or tap **More info** on an item on the brief page and paste the request here, and I'll dig in.

items.headline_md: **Trump** says he wants a **"permanent"** deal with **Iran** that no future president could undo
items.summary_md: "Even if, in four, 15, or 20 years, we have an incompetent president, the agreement I reach will be permanent," he said Saturday.

items.headline_md: Iran says an air-defense missile damaged a **US F-16** over the Gulf; **CENTCOM denies it**, saying all US fighters are accounted for
items.summary_md: Iran's foreign minister said the **Strait of Hormuz** stays closed until the US accepts Iran's conditions.

items.headline_md: Iranian forces reportedly attack **three oil tankers** near the Strait of Hormuz as Iran shows off a new underground missile launcher
items.summary_md: The UK's maritime security center reported no casualties.

items.headline_md: A fire at a candy factory in Indonesia's **Banten** province kills at least **3**, with **36 missing**
items.summary_md: About 300 workers were inside; at least 15 were rescued and the cause is under investigation.

items.headline_md: **UNIFIL** begins handing positions in southern Lebanon to the Lebanese army before its mandate ends Dec. 31
items.summary_md: Its chief stressed avoiding any security vacuum.

items.headline_md: **Trump** says the US will put a **"tremendous tax"** on American companies that build **data centers abroad**
items.summary_md: Developers such as Equinix and Digital Realty run facilities overseas, and a penalty could complicate the global AI buildout.

items.headline_md: **Amazon** is in advanced talks to buy AI startup **Decart** in a deal worth up to **$7.5B**, per the FT
items.summary_md: It could be announced as early as next week.

items.headline_md: Trump vows to work with the incoming **Democratic Congress** to cap **credit card rates at 10%**
items.summary_md: The current median rate is 22.2%; researchers say a cap could save Americans $100B a year.

items.headline_md: Update: some **GTA VI** PS5 players report crashes with error **CE-108255-1**; Rockstar hasn't announced a fix
items.summary_md: Reported via Numerama and GameSpot, after Take-Two's $3.79B day-one figure.

items.headline_md: Toby Fox says **Deltarune Chapter 6** is playable start to finish and aimed at **2027**; work on the final Chapter 7 has begun
items.summary_md: From his fall newsletter, per Polygon and Kotaku.

items.headline_md: Nintendo will sell its **Zelda Ocarina** instruments (€34.99 / €49.99) in Europe **by invitation only**; sign-ups close **today**
items.summary_md: You need 10+ hours of Ocarina of Time on Switch 2 before Nov 18 and a European-region account.

items.headline_md: Hyper-casual: **PlayDucky**'s founders buy out their first investor to become **majority owners**
items.summary_md: The profitable studio raised $1M in 2021 for hyper-casual games and now centers on Melon Sandbox (110-person team).

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: still public as [CafeRecomp](https://github.com/hardkiller2565123123/CafeRecomp) (BOTW first), and its [Releases page](https://github.com/hardkiller2565123123/CafeRecomp/releases) still has no tagged release. GTA VI: still no verified native-PC recomp or port; [Leonida](https://github.com/itsnotrexed/leonida) translates shaders and extracts assets but can't boot yet. Nov 21 builds include PCSX2 v2.9.186, RPCS3, Xenia/Xenia Edge, Dolphin 2609-301, DuckStation and Azahar 2127.0 rc5 ([EmuCR](https://www.emucr.com/2026_11_21_archive.html)).

items.headline_md: **PS5**: **ZeraPS5 v0.1.1 (build 1080)** adds fixes for **Longshot** and **R-Type Delta HD** plus Vulkan/shader and memory work
items.summary_md: It's an AI-assisted, experimental Windows PS5 emulator and can now read some .ffpfsc game images directly.

items.headline_md: Update, **Switch 2**: **Hokkaido 0.7.1** for Android moves to **Banana Native v0.3.45** native ports, with Pokopia, Donkey Kong Bananza and Mario Tennis Fever fixes
items.summary_md: Tested on Galaxy S24, S25 and S26 phones.

items.headline_md: **RetroBat 8.4.0** goes stable, making **Sega Model 1** its own system and adding new systems and light-gun fixes
items.summary_md: Pushed to GitHub Saturday night, two weeks after the beta.

items.headline_md: NES emulator **FCEUX 2.8.0** adds **RetroAchievements**, a Lua debugger, a profiler and a gamepad-driven UI
items.summary_md: The Qt GUI gains dark mode, dockable tools and saved layouts.

items.headline_md: Update: **Sunrise on the Reaping** now projects a **$120M** opening after a $56M Friday, with an **A- CinemaScore**
items.summary_md: PLF and Imax screens make up 47% of the weekend, and it's playing strong in the South and Midwest.

items.headline_md: This week: Disney's **Hexed** and Universal's **Focker-in-Law** open for Thanksgiving, tracking **$40M–$50M** each over five days
items.summary_md: Deadline says Sunrise's second weekend could beat both.

items.headline_md: **Pinewood** says it's "talking about" hosting **Robert Pattinson**'s Bond film: "We're the home of Bond"
items.summary_md: Nothing is confirmed yet under Amazon MGM.

items.headline_md: **Jennifer Lopez** says she and **Jane Fonda** are "talking about maybe doing another" **Monster-in-Law**
items.summary_md: From a Drew Barrymore Show clip.

items.headline_md: Update: **two groups independently verify** Levent Alpöge's claim that **Claude** helped prove the **Riemann hypothesis**
items.summary_md: They reviewed the Lean code he shared; he says it took about six weeks.

items.headline_md: Thinking Machines releases **Inkling 2 Mini**, a laptop-sized open-weights looped MoE model
items.summary_md: It claims the lead among open models under 100B parameters on DeepSWE v1.1 (48.2%).

items.headline_md: The **Gemini** Android app gets a redesigned inline camera, plus **GIF creation**
items.summary_md: The new camera opens as a draggable bottom sheet.

items.headline_md: The **FBI** is investigating an apparent breach of its **National Crime Information Center** database
items.summary_md: It's the nationwide system linking federal, state and local police; the FBI hasn't commented.

items.headline_md: App stores: Apple's age-rating questionnaire now asks about **shared location** and **dating** features, which can change an app's rating
items.summary_md: In effect since Nov 16, by region.

items.headline_md: Ads: **AppLovin** is reportedly in talks to buy ad-tech firm **Criteo**, per Reuters
items.summary_md: No deal has been reached, and terms aren't known.

sections.title: Markets
sections.body_md: It's the weekend, so there are no US stock, futures, oil or gold quotes this morning.

items.headline_md: Crypto at 5:08 AM CT: **Bitcoin $60,887 (+5.2%)**, **Ether $1,709.65 (+4.3%)** over 24 hours
items.summary_md: A bounce after Friday's selloff.

items.headline_md: Week recap: the **S&P 500** is in a **correction**, down more than 10% from its Oct. 6 high, after its worst week in over 18 months
items.summary_md: The Nasdaq composite is now negative for the year.

sections.title: Weather
sections.body_md:
No ice storm or tornado threat for the St. Louis area in the next 7 days (NWS/SPC). No active NWS alerts at either point ([NWS alerts](https://api.weather.gov/alerts/active?point=38.7875,-90.6299)). NWS St. Louis says today's cold front brings rain and much cooler air, with afternoon "highs" only near 50° and northwest gusts up to 30 mph, then seasonably cool weather through the week; there's a slight chance (15–25%) of "very light, non-accumulating, unimpactful snow" Wednesday into early Thanksgiving Day ([NWS St. Louis discussion](https://forecast.weather.gov/product.php?site=LSX&issuedby=LSX&product=AFD), issued 1:34 AM CT). SPC: today's severe risk is in South Texas ([Day 1](https://www.spc.noaa.gov/products/outlook/day1otlk.html)); severe storms unlikely Monday ([Day 2](https://www.spc.noaa.gov/products/outlook/day2otlk.html)) and not expected Tuesday ([Day 3](https://www.spc.noaa.gov/products/outlook/day3otlk.html)); "severe potential appears limited" for Wed–Sun ([Day 4–8](https://www.spc.noaa.gov/products/exper/day4-8/)). I didn't check the WPC winter outlooks, and the LSX Hazardous Weather Outlook page came back empty.
